name: auto-model-router-mp
description: Single-plugin marketplace for auto-model-router — per-prompt model + effort routing for Claude Code (haiku/sonnet/opus by intent classification), parallel wave execution for plan-mode and multi-part prompts, and a goal-anchored usage report (cost saved / correction rate / time-to-results).

plugins.name: auto-model-router
plugins.description: Routes every prompt to the cheapest sufficient model: a heuristic + Haiku classifier picks a tier and effort score, then auto-delegates to a router-{haiku|sonnet|opus} worker subagent at high confidence and asks when ambiguous. Plan-mode and multi-part prompts fan out into parallel waves with disjoint-file safety, and /router-report scores the cost saved, correction rate, and time-to-results.
